purpose: simulate the frozen confirmatory binomial mixed model over a prespecified planning surface after nuisance parameters and external SESOI are frozen

forbidden: theoretical 0.25 information ceiling as behavioral effect size

required: bypass-control fixed primary-success probability at B1/B2/B3
ordinary contingent-minus-fixed access effect at B1/B2/B3
ordinary routeable-minus-bypass fixed-access effect at B1/B2/B3
baseline_surface.rule: planning assumptions must be declared independently of focal confirmatory outcomes; the 12-cell surface is then constructed to realize frozen H1/H2 SESOI exactly

required: individual random-intercept SD on logit scale
colony random-intercept SD on logit scale when multiple colonies are used
actual/planned complete treatment-block count contributed by each colony; the vector must sum to individuals per cell
nuisance.preferred_source: frozen procedural-pilot nuisance receipt plus actual husbandry allocation

simulation.model: success ~ architecture * access_mode * categorical_budget + (1|individual) + (1|colony) when colony_count>1
simulation.timeout_process: timeout is generated first and scores primary success 0; cell primary-success probabilities are realized at zero random effects by conditional correctness p/(1-timeout)
simulation.dropout_process: randomized individuals drop before trial generation; simulations losing an entire treatment cell are fit failures
simulation.fit_failure_policy: fit failures count as H1/H2 failures in the operating-characteristic denominator and are reported separately
simulation.singular_fit_policy: singularity is reported; a numerically completed singular fit is not silently discarded from the replicate ledger
simulation.contrast_estimation: population-average H1/H2 over the fitted combined random-intercept distribution using deterministic Gaussian quadrature; delta-method fixed-effect uncertainty conditional on fitted variance components
simulation.multiplicity: H1 directional interpretation after two-sided alpha; H2 hierarchical pass requires H1 pass and H2 directional two-sided rejection
simulation.cell_probability_semantics: scenario cell probabilities are target population-average primary-success probabilities, not zero-random-effect probabilities
simulation.random_effect_calibration: for each cell, the simulator solves the latent conditional-correctness logit so that integrating over the prespecified combined individual+colony normal random-intercept distribution and multiplying by 1-timeout reproduces the target population-average primary-success probability
simulation.variance_component_uncertainty: reported operating characteristics do not add a second delta-method term for uncertainty in fitted random-effect variances; this limitation is fixed and must be retained in interpretation
simulation.colony_allocation: each treatment cell receives exactly the same prespecified colony_block_counts vector, matching complete within-colony 12-cell randomization blocks

outputs: replicate-level fit success, convergence, singularity, H1/H2 estimates, SEs, p-values and hierarchical pass flags
mean H1/H2 estimates among successful fits
population-average contrast estimates use fitted random-intercept integration rather than zero-random-effect cell predictions

required: procedural pilot nuisance receipt frozen without focal contrast opening
actual/planned colony complete-block allocation vector frozen or included in the prespecified robustness surface
operating-characteristic grid includes multiple plausible nuisance/baseline scenarios rather than one favorable point
selected individuals-per-cell meets the predeclared H1/H2 operating-characteristic criterion across the required robustness surface
final_N_promotion_rule.forbidden: do not select N from the most favorable scenario or rerun the grid after viewing confirmatory outcomes

software_fixture_boundary: CI may use arbitrary synthetic nuisance/effect values solely to verify code execution. Fixture outputs are never scientific planning results and must not enter the readiness ledger as power evidence.
claim_ceiling: The simulator can freeze and audit final sample-size operating characteristics once real nuisance and external-effect inputs exist. Code readiness alone does not justify a biological N.
